scenes.title: Office · TV
scenes.instruction: Walk straight to the glass wall, then turn right and stop in front of the large TV set.

scenes.title: Hallway · Red carpet
scenes.instruction: Turn left and go straight. Walk until you reach the red carpet and stop.

scenes.title: Campus · Chair
scenes.instruction: Go straight. On the left, there is a brown recliner. Walk over there and stop.

notes: Original 1280x640 10fps panoramas and 1920x1080 HLG external recordings composed on a 3840x2160 30fps canvas.
Fixed camera start offsets; hold final phone frame if the recording ends before the panorama.
No masks or source capture metadata. Original camera audio is replaced with licensed instrumental music.
